title: Classic Sri Lanka Discovery
description: A refined first journey through Sri Lanka, blending ancient heritage, sacred Kandy, misty tea country, Ella, wildlife and the southern coast.
inclusions: Scenic train tickets subject to availability
days: Meet your private driver-guide and travel into the Cultural Triangle. Visit Dambulla Cave Temple before settling into the Sigiriya area.
Climb the iconic rock fortress in the cooler morning hours, then slow down with a countryside village experience.
Continue through the island's cultural heartland to Kandy and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth.
Travel through emerald tea country on the celebrated hill-country railway and arrive in Ella.
Discover Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak and the relaxed mountain atmosphere.
Descend toward the south-east and enter the wildlife region around Yala.
Enjoy a safari experience, then continue to the southern coast and historic Galle Fort.
Enjoy a final coastal morning before your private airport transfer.

title: Cultural Triangle & Ancient Kingdoms
description: A heritage-focused journey through Sri Lanka's ancient capitals, sacred caves, monumental ruins and the royal city of Kandy.
days: Travel inland and visit the historic Dambulla Cave Temple before continuing to Sigiriya.
Explore the fifth-century rock citadel, gardens and frescoes, followed by a relaxed rural experience.
Discover the medieval royal capital, ancient reservoirs and the remarkable Gal Vihara.
Travel south through the central region and arrive in Kandy for its sacred heritage.
Visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth, Kandy Lake and the Royal Botanical Gardens.
Private transfer back to Colombo or the airport for your onward journey.

title: Tea Country & Ella Escape
description: A slower journey through Sri Lanka's cool central highlands, tea estates, waterfalls and one of the world's great scenic rail journeys.
inclusions: Scenic train segment subject to availability
days: Climb into the central highlands with waterfall and tea-country stops along the way.
Visit a working tea estate and factory, learn about Ceylon tea and enjoy the cool hill-country atmosphere.
Board the scenic train and watch tea-covered valleys and mountain landscapes unfold.
Walk to Nine Arch Bridge and choose Little Adam's Peak or a relaxed afternoon in town.
Descend from the mountains toward the tropical south with scenic stops en route.

title: Wild Sri Lanka Safari
description: An island journey designed around wildlife, combining the Cultural Triangle and hill country with a dedicated Yala safari experience.
exclusions: Park and entrance fees unless specified
days: Travel inland with a Dambulla stop and settle into the jungle landscape around Sigiriya.
Climb Sigiriya and enjoy an optional wildlife experience according to seasonal conditions.
Continue to Kandy and explore its sacred temple district.
Ride the scenic hill-country railway into the mountains.
Enjoy Ella in the morning before descending toward the national park region.
Set out by safari jeep in search of elephants, leopards and abundant birdlife.
Continue toward the coast and transfer to the airport according to your flight schedule.

title: Southern Coast & Beach Retreat
description: A relaxed private escape along Sri Lanka's tropical south, combining Galle's heritage with golden beaches, ocean sunsets and free time.
days: Meet your driver and travel south to historic Galle and the Indian Ocean coast.
Explore the fort's ramparts, lanes, cafés and boutiques before sunset.
Follow the coast south with time to relax on the beach.
Enjoy a free day for swimming, cafés and optional seasonal whale watching.
Travel north along the coast with optional lagoon and village experiences.
Enjoy a final beach morning before your private airport transfer.

title: Grand Sri Lanka Private Journey
description: Our signature island circuit: ancient heritage, tea country, Ella's famous railway, wildlife and the southern coast in one seamless private journey.
inclusions: Scenic train segment subject to availability
days: Warm airport welcome and a gentle first evening beside the coast.
Travel north to the Cultural Triangle with a Dambulla stop.
Enjoy Sigiriya early, then explore the ancient royal city of Polonnaruwa.
Journey south through the cultural heartland to Kandy.
Visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth, Kandy Lake and botanical gardens.
Climb into tea country with plantation and waterfall stops.
Take the celebrated hill-country train through tea estates and mountain valleys.
Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak and a relaxed mountain evening.
Descend through the south-east toward the national park.
A dedicated wildlife day with safari options according to park conditions.
Continue to the coast and explore historic Galle Fort.
Final beach moments and private transfer to the airport.
